opportunity.title: Municipal Financial Management System Software, Application Hosting, Implementation and Technology Services

supports: RFP 2026-06 is listed as a current City procurement opportunity
buyer seeks an off-the-shelf municipal financial management system plus hosting, implementation and technology services
mandatory finance scope includes GL/fund accounting, budgeting, procurement, vendors, AP, AR, payroll, cashiering, cash management, bank reconciliation and reporting
mandatory utility scope includes customer accounts, rates/fees, billing, payments, integrations and delinquency management
testing and implementation validation includes system testing, data validation and UAT
evaluation allocates 20 points to implementation/data conversion and 15 to technology/hosting/security/integration
minimum qualifications require an established commercially supported government financial/ERP solution and successful municipal or government implementations

source_refresh.reason: The RFP schedule says written responses to questions are targeted for 2026-09-18; proposal-facing use must recheck the official procurement page before outreach or submission support.

non_inferences: TJLabs is not represented as the municipal ERP software prime
no candidate prime is known to be bidding from this packet
no buyer contact or submission is authorized by this packet
no buyer acceptance, contract, invoice, receivable, payment, cash or recognized revenue exists
a TJLabs evidence receipt cannot create bank, payroll, ERP, go-live or buyer authority
